target.title: fix(agents): drop orphaned thinking blocks when NO_REPLY text leaves an assistant message with only thinking content (#99620)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

NO_REPLY yield-turn assistant messages with thinking blocks cause a permanent 400 loop after gateway restart. Dropping the NO_REPLY text without the companion thinking block leaves orphaned thinking blocks that merge with adjacent assistant messages into `[thinking, thinking, tool_use]`, which Anthropic rejects as "cannot be modified."

- **Observed impact**: 5 production sessions bricked in a single day (2026-07-03) per issue reporter. Each session requires a manual `/new` to recover.
- **Root cause chain**: `normalizeAssistantReplayBlockContent` drops NO_REPLY text but preserves thinking → yield artifacts cleaned up → adjacent assistant merge → `[thinking, thinking, tool_use]` → HTTP 400
- **Fix location**: `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/replay-history.ts` in `normalizeAssistantReplayBlockContent`

## Evidence

### Real behavior proof

Ran `normalizeAssistantReplayContent` (the real exported function, not mocked) against a 3-message replay sequence that reproduces the yield-turn artifact:

```
Input:  user → assistant[thinking, "NO_REPLY"] → assistant[thinking, "real text"]
```

#### Before fix (`origin/main`)

```console
BEFORE FIX (main):
Input count: 3 → Output count: 3
  [0] user types=[text]
  [1] assistant types=[thinking]       ← ORPHANED! thinking block alone
  [2] assistant types=[thinking, text]
Orphaned thinking dropped: false
```

The orphaned `[thinking]` message survives. On replay, `validateAnthropicTurns` merges the two adjacent assistants → `[thinking, thinking, tool_use]` → HTTP 400.

#### After fix (PR #99772)

```console
AFTER FIX (PR #99772):
Input count: 3 → Output count: 2
  [0] user types=[text]
  [1] assistant types=[thinking, text] ← orphaned msg DROPPED
Orphaned thinking dropped: true
User preserved: true
Real assistant preserved: true
ALL PASSED: true
```

The orphaned thinking-only assistant is removed. Only one assistant with `[thinking, text]` remains → clean payload → Anthropic accepts.

#### Comparison

| Assertion | Before (main) | After (PR) |
|---|---|---|
| Output count | 3 | **2** ✅ |
| Orphaned thinking block | Survives | **Dropped** ✅ |
| User message preserved | ✅ | ✅ |
| Real assistant preserved | ✅ | ✅ |

#### How to reproduce

```bash
# Requires this PR branch checked out
node --import tsx -e "
import {normalizeAssistantReplayContent} from './src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/replay-history.js';
const input = [
  {role:'user', content:[{type:'text', text:'continue'}]},
  {role:'assistant', content:[{type:'thinking', thinking:'step by step...'}, {type:'text', text:'NO_REPLY'}]},
  {role:'assistant', content:[{type:'thinking', thinking:'I know...'}, {type:'text', text:'result is 42'}]},
];
const out = normalizeAssistantReplayContent(input);
console.log('Input:', input.length, '→ Output:', out.length);
console.log('Orphaned dropped:', out.length < input.length);
"
```

No API key, no gateway setup, no mocks — just the real OpenClaw runtime.

### Test results

| Suite | Tests | Status |
|---|---|---|
| replay-history.test.ts | 33 (4 new + 29 existing) | All pass |
| thinking.test.ts | 48 | All pass |
| sanitize-session-history.test.ts | 76 | All pass |

## Root Cause

`normalizeAssistantReplayBlockContent` drops silent-reply text blocks but preserves companion thinking blocks. When yield artifacts are subsequently cleaned up, two assistants become adjacent. `validateAnthropicTurns` merges them, producing `[thinking, thinking, tool_use]` — rejected by Anthropic.

## Risks and Mitigations

- **tool_use companion present**: Guarded — only orphaned thinking (no tool_use, no text) triggers the drop.
- **Compatibility**: No config, env, or migration impact.

## AI Assistance

- **AI-assisted**: Yes
- **Co-Authored-By**: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>
